description: Beneath a frame, an arguments section and a locals section are each emitted only when they have at least one entry, preserving insertion order, with both omitted when empty. Argument values have control and non-printable characters escaped onto a single line; ordinary local values are shown as supplied.

python_frames.source:
x = "This is the line 1"
x = "This is the line 2"
x = "This is the line 3"
x = "This is the line 4"

cases.expected_output:
Traceback for thread 1 [] (most recent call last):
    (Python) File "f.py", line 1, in fn
        x = "This is the line 1"
      Locals:
        only_local: present
